human_confirmation.statement: 确认标注并采用 AI 辅助口径（推荐）
human_confirmation.scope: 5 个正常导入 case 的 AI 辅助标注与原稿缺失/未知口径

quality.evidence_completeness_semantics: All 15 planned attempts have a completed result with a terminal business status or explicit runner error. Each comparison has verifiable fields or records zero credit from the actual failed attempt; failed slots retain the fixed 48-question denominator. This is protocol completeness, not a quality success threshold.

resource_observation.scope: Actual quality import windows include scanned/image/mixed OCR when page evidence records OCR. Each simultaneous sum is the maximum of real within-sample component sums, never a sum of independent component maxima. Group maxima describe observations only; incomplete windows retain null budget conclusions.

import_performance.resource_workload_scope: The performance inputs are the fixed 1/10/50-page text workloads; recorded actual OCR page counts determine whether OCR ran. OCR memory observations are separately available in quality.resource_observation.
import_performance.memory_scope: Maximum observed per-run window values; simultaneous sum is an actual sample sum, not sum of component maxima. Shared PostgreSQL container RSS can double-count shared pages.

overall_observed_app_peak_scope: Largest actual sampled application-window observation across quality and all performance runs, including separately identified warmups. This is a descriptive observation with its own window completeness, not a replacement for any missing per-run measurement and not a new acceptance gate.
